articles.title: Texas Tech no longer controls its destiny after disastrous Cincinnati loss - USA Today
articles.description: Texas Tech’s unbeaten season is over after a 37-24 loss at Cincinnati, dealing a major blow to its Big 12 title defense and CFP hopes.
